root.command: SELECT Now() AS CurrentTestDate, DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AS WindowStart_6DaysOut, DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AS WindowEnd_10DaysOut, 'Customers need NextCoffeeBy BETWEEN these dates to appear in checkup' AS Explanation

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, '---NextCoffeeBy (Checkup System)---' AS Separator1, cu.NextCoffeeBy AS NextCoffeeBy_UsedByCheckup, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, IIF(cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()), '? IN WINDOW - Will appear', '? OUTSIDE WINDOW - Will NOT appear') AS CheckupWindowStatus, '---NextDateRequired (Recurring System)---' AS Separator2, (SELECT MIN(ro.NextDateRequired) FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True) AS NextDateRequired_RecurringOrders, (SELECT DateDiff("d", Now(), MIN(ro.NextDateRequired)) FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND ro.Enabled = True) AS DaysUntilRecurringOrder, '---Other Flags---' AS Separator3, c.enabled AS CustomerEnabled, c.PredictionDisabled AS PredictionDisabled, c.EmailAddress FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%' ORDER BY c.CompanyName

SELECT c.CompanyName, ro.ReoccuranceType, ro.[Value] AS RecurringValue, ro.DateLastDone, ro.NextDateRequired, DateDiff("d", Now(), ro.NextDateRequired) AS DaysUntilNextRequired, ro.Enabled AS RecurringOrderEnabled, IIF(ro.NextDateRequired <= Now(), '?? OVERDUE - Should auto-create order', IIF(ro.NextDateRequired <= DateAdd("d", 3, Now()), '? UPCOMING - Will auto-create soon', '? FUTURE - Scheduled')) AS RecurringOrderStatus FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%' ORDER BY c.CompanyName, ro.NextDateRequired

SELECT c.CompanyName, '?? Recurring Orders (Automatic)' AS SystemType, (SELECT MIN(ro.NextDateRequired) FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl ro WHERE ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) AS DateUsed, 'Orders auto-create when NextDateRequired arrives. No checkup email needed.' AS Purpose FROM CustomersTbl AS c WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.CompanyName, '?? Coffee Checkup (Manual Reminder)' AS SystemType, cu.NextCoffeeBy AS DateUsed, 'Sends email reminder when customer will run out in 6-10 days. Only for non-recurring customers.' AS Purpose FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%' ORDER BY CompanyName, SystemType DESC

SELECT c.CompanyName, o.RoastDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), o.RoastDate) AS DaysUntilRoast, IIF(o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()), '? Would EXCLUDE from checkup (recent order exists)', '? Would NOT exclude') AS CheckupImpact FROM OrdersTbl AS o INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE (c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ridwaan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Akhalwaya%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Ryan%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE '%Vermooten%') AND o.RoastDate >= DateAdd("d", -7, Now()) AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 14, Now()) ORDER BY c.CompanyName, o.RoastDate

SELECT TOP 10 c.CompanyName, cu.NextCoffeeBy, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, '? These ARE in the 6-10 day window' AS Status FROM CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID WHERE cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND c.enabled = True AND c.PredictionDisabled = False ORDER BY cu.NextCoffeeBy

SELECT '?? SUMMARY' AS Section, 'Ridwaan and Ryan are NOT in checkup because:' AS Finding, '1. Their NextCoffeeBy dates are OUTSIDE the 6-10 day window' AS Reason1, '2. They have active recurring orders that auto-create orders' AS Reason2, '3. This is EXPECTED and CORRECT behavior' AS Conclusion
UNION ALL
SELECT '?? WHAT HAPPENS NEXT' AS Section, 'When NextDateRequired arrives:' AS Finding, '1. System auto-creates order for them (no email needed)' AS Reason1, '2. They will get order confirmation, not checkup reminder' AS Reason2, '3. No action required from admin' AS Conclusion
UNION ALL
SELECT '?? IF YOU WANT THEM IN CHECKUP' AS Section, 'You would need to:' AS Finding, '1. Update their NextCoffeeBy to be 6-10 days from now' AS Reason1, '2. But this conflicts with their recurring order schedule' AS Reason2, '3. NOT RECOMMENDED - let recurring orders handle them' AS Conclusion
